title: Discover sessions
scenario: Find suitable public upcoming sessions without requiring sign in.
prerequisites: Healthy configured service; seeded public/private, open/cancelled, full/non-full sessions. Use a fixed clock T. Start each subcase with cleared filters.

cases.action: Open Discover anonymously, then while signed in.
cases.inputs: Same fixture and empty filters.
cases.expected: Both visitors can view the same public results. Joining may separately require sign in.
cases.actual: The production anonymous API returned an empty page, and both anonymous and signed-in browser sessions displayed Find Your Next Game and No sessions found. Neoh Session QA was created and signed in. The comparison covers the naturally empty dataset only; populated-session equivalence and the join sign-in flow remain untested.

production_execution.remaining_scope: Populated-session equivalence and join sign-in behavior; signed-in/anonymous empty comparison was observed separately in the browser.

cases.actual_summary: Anonymous and signed-in views both empty; populated comparison not run.

authenticated_browser_observations.expected: Signed-in Discover renders the same empty result as the anonymous run
authenticated_browser_observations.actual: Signed-in Find Your Next Game rendered All upcoming public sessions and No sessions found

authenticated_browser_scope.interface: Signed-in production browser UI; HTTP response status not captured
authenticated_browser_scope.remaining_scope: Populated-session equivalence and join sign-in behavior.

cases.action: Refresh the list for each fixture.
cases.inputs: PUBLIC/PRIVATE; OPEN/CANCELLED; full/non-full; future start.
cases.expected: Only PUBLIC and OPEN sessions appear. A full eligible session remains listed.
cases.actual: Not run. The signed-in account exists, but /payouts is unavailable and no owned session was created. Controlled public/private, open/cancelled and full/non-full fixtures remain absent.
cases.actual_summary: No controlled visibility/state fixtures; payout setup unavailable.

cases.action: Search with the server clock fixed at T.
cases.inputs: Starts T-1ms, T, T+1ms.
cases.expected: Only the session starting at T+1ms appears.
cases.actual: Not run. Requires a fixed clock and sessions at T-1ms, T and T+1ms.
cases.actual_summary: Not run. Requires a fixed clock and sessions at T-1ms, T and T+1ms.

cases.action: Submit each search text independently.
cases.inputs: Empty; mixed-case matching venue; no match; literal % or _.
cases.expected: Empty gives unrestricted results; matching is case-insensitive; no match gives an empty state; wildcard characters are literal.
cases.actual: Production empty, % and _ queries each returned HTTP 200 and an empty page. This proves query acceptance only; an empty uncontrolled dataset cannot establish case-insensitive matching, literal wildcard behavior or the matching/nonmatching partitions. Browser empty-state rendering was also observed.

production_execution.remaining_scope: Controlled matching, mixed-case, nonmatching and literal-punctuation fixtures.

cases.actual_summary: Empty and punctuation queries accepted; no matching fixtures.

cases.action: Submit query q using the API or filter form.
cases.inputs: 99, 100 and 101 characters after trimming.
cases.expected: 99 and 100 are accepted; 101 is rejected with a search validation error.
cases.actual: Production GET accepted trimmed query lengths 99 and 100 with HTTP 200; length 101 returned HTTP 400 INVALID_REQUEST. A 100-character value surrounded by spaces also returned 200. All specified API length subcases passed. Browser checks independently accepted 99/100 and displayed Search must be 100 characters or fewer for 101.

production_execution.remaining_scope: None for listed length subcases; API and browser evidence retained separately.

cases.actual_summary: 99/100 accepted; 101 rejected in API and browser. Trim check passes in API.

cases.action: Filter 1 Nov 2026, 18:00 to 20:00 Singapore time.
cases.expected: Include the middle two sessions; the lower bound is inclusive and upper bound exclusive.
cases.actual: Production accepted date=2026-11-01, timeFrom=18:00 and timeTo=20:00 with HTTP 200 and an empty page. No sessions at the four specified boundary instants were available, so inclusive/exclusive result filtering was not established.

production_execution.remaining_scope: Controlled sessions at 17:59:59.999, 18:00, 19:59:59.999 and 20:00 Singapore time, all still upcoming.

cases.actual_summary: Range accepted; exact boundary sessions unavailable.

cases.action: Submit each malformed query separately.
cases.inputs: Impossible date; time without date; equal/reversed times; duplicate sport; unknown sport.
cases.expected: Validation fails for the affected field. No successful result set is presented for the invalid query.
cases.actual: Production GET rejected all stated malformed-query subcases with HTTP 400 INVALID_REQUEST: impossible date, time without date, equal/reversed time bounds, duplicate sport and unknown sport. Supplemental invalid time, region, cursor characters and oversized cursor checks also passed. The API returned the documented generic error envelope; the browser observations below separately test selected field messages. Browser checks separately displayed Choose a date when filtering by time and End time must be later than start time on the same day for equal/reversed bounds.

production_execution.remaining_scope: Remaining browser malformed-URL field displays were not run; all specified API subcases passed.

cases.actual_summary: All invalid API cases rejected; browser time errors also observed.

cases.action: Load results and follow the returned next cursor.
cases.inputs: 0, 1, 20 and 21 matching sessions.
cases.expected: Empty state for 0; correct results for 1 and 20; first page has 20 for 21 matches, with the final result on the next page and no duplicates.
cases.actual: Production baseline naturally returned the zero-result API page (items=[], nextCursor=null). The 1-, 20- and 21-result fixtures and next-page behavior were not exercised. The browser displayed No sessions found.

production_execution.remaining_scope: Controlled 1/20/21 matching-session fixtures and pagination without duplicates.

cases.actual_summary: API and browser empty state pass; 1/20/21 fixtures unavailable.

title: Create a session

cases.actual: Not run at the specified API boundary. Neoh Session QA now exists and is signed in, but completed payout setup is absent. The otherwise-valid wizard draft showed Complete your payout account setup before creating a session. /payouts remained unavailable after Try again, so no owned session was created. Omitted API defaults and successful persistence were not exercised.

title: Change session visibility
scenario: Allow an eligible owner to set PUBLIC or PRIVATE while protecting capacity and lifecycle rules.
prerequisites: Active owner and separate non-owner account. OPEN future session with at least one available place. Keep an independent Discover page open for propagation cases.

cases.action: In hosted sessions, set visibility to PUBLIC.
cases.inputs: Eligible owner; PRIVATE session; one free place.
cases.expected: Success shows confirmed PUBLIC state. A healthy visible online Discover page includes it within the three-second target.
cases.actual: Not run. Signed-in account exists, but no owned OPEN future session could be created while payout setup remained unavailable.
cases.actual_summary: No owned OPEN session; payout setup unavailable.

cases.action: Set visibility to PRIVATE.
cases.inputs: Eligible PUBLIC session.
cases.expected: Success confirms PRIVATE. The healthy foreground discovery list removes it within three seconds.
cases.actual: Not run. Signed-in account exists, but no owned PUBLIC future session is available; payout setup prevents creating the fixture.
cases.actual_summary: No owned PUBLIC session; payout setup unavailable.

cases.action: Request the change using each rejected identity.
cases.inputs: Non-owner; inactive owner; unauthenticated request.
cases.expected: Access is rejected; stored visibility is unchanged. API responses are 403 for foreign/inactive access and 401 without authentication.
cases.actual: The anonymous visibility PATCH returned HTTP 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. The inactive-owner and non-owner branches were not exercised because the required account/session fixtures remain unavailable. No existing session identifier was used and no visibility mutation occurred.
cases.actual_summary: Anonymous API request rejected 401; inactive/non-owner cases not run.

authenticated_api_scope.remaining_scope: Inactive-owner and non-owner account/session fixtures, including stored-visibility assertions.
